p.i: Et tantum horrescens Mars sceleris ipse
Testor numen, ait, non te Mars strauit, & ip[?]
Istud tu vulnus Gallia tota lues.
Dixerat, euentúsque ist ac iam vera probau
Nec pudor est nondum vos sapuisse Ph[?]

main_text.head: ILLVSTRISSIMI ET [?]tentissimi Principis, FRIDERICI Comitis Palatini ad Rhenum, Rom. Imperij Archidapiferi, & Electoris, Ducis Bauariæ, &c.
MEMORIÆ.
main_text.p: Qui cum prisca Fides, Pietásque antiqua nascens Surgebat, tumulo nunc, FRIDERICE, [?] Fallor ego: an potius Pietás, Fidésque cad[?] Æthereas sursum traxit ad ssque dom[?] Viue igitur felix, cœli nouus incola Princep[?] Quo non digna satis Principe terra fuit[?]

page.notes: The right edge of the scan cuts off the ends of most lines, so the line endings are missing and marked [?]. The large initial Q of MEMORIÆ is set as an ornamental capital and is joined to its word. Doubtful readings are marked [?].
